interface.longDescription: MCP tools over the frozen echo-adk contract (FORGE loopback service): health, agent definitions, one-shot runs with a Proof verdict, and echoBots — always-on governed agents that start paused, hold one exact-scope Lease per turn, keep their own memory scope, and carry a daily cost cap of at most $5. Bots resume only on Bob's explicit word. STATUS: manifest only — ChatGPT apps need a publicly reachable MCP endpoint, and echo-adk-api is loopback-only on FORGE by design. Live wiring waits on an Echo-gateway MCP endpoint for the ADK contract (Bob's call). See CUSTOM-GPT-INSTRUCTIONS.md for the no-endpoint fallback.
interface.shortDescription: Governed Echo agents and echoBots in ChatGPT
